bus.via: Queen Street Terminal to JB Custom Out

trips.route_note: Take the shuttle train or a bus from Woodlands or Queen Street to Johor Bahru across the Causeway; allow time for two immigration checks.
trips.tour_query: Johor Bahru day trip from Singapore
trips.why: The direct bus from Queen Street Terminal is cheap and takes about 1 hour, far less than the 30 SGD taxi for a similar road distance.
know: Allow extra time for two immigration checks at the Causeway.
Bus fares start from about $3-$10, and the shuttle train from Woodlands is an alternative.
